Lead mechanical capital projects from design to commissioning while enjoying a 5:2 roster   Your new company    Our client is a leading Australian resources organisation with a strong focus on operational excellence, innovation, and sustainable growth. With significant investment in asset upgrades and infrastructure improvements, they offer the opportunity to work on challenging and rewarding projects within a supportive and high-performing team. 
   Your new role    As a Mechanical Project Manager, you will be responsible for delivering a portfolio of mechanical capital projects from concept through to commissioning and handover. Working closely with engineering consultants, contractors, operations teams, and key stakeholders, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with business objectives. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Managing mechanical projects through all phases of the project life cycle 
 Coordinating consultants during scoping, study, and detailed design stages 
 Managing project schedules, budgets, risks, and reporting requirements 
 Overseeing contractor performance and ensuring contractual obligations are met 
 Leading project execution, construction activities, commissioning, and handover 
 Ensuring project documentation is maintained and complies with governance requirements 
 Collaborating with maintenance, operations, engineering, and site leadership teams 
 Monitoring project performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives 
 Ensuring all works are completed in accordance with safety, quality, and environmental standards 
 
   What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Demonstrated experience managing mechanical projects within mining, resources, heavy industry, manufacturing, or infrastructure environments 
 Proven experience managing consultants through early study and detailed design phases 
 Experience delivering projects through execution, construction, and commissioning 
 Strong understanding of project governance, project controls, and delivery documentation 
 Sound knowledge of contract administration and contractor management 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills 
 Ability to manage multiple project priorities in a fast-paced operational environment 
 Mechanical Engineering qualifications or a Mechanical Trade background will be highly regarded. 
 Commitment to maintaining high safety and operational standards 
 
   What you'll get in return  
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a leading mining operation and play a key role in the delivery of critical mechanical infrastructure and asset improvement projects. You'll enjoy a Monday-to-Thursday site-based roster with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays, camp accommodation provided, and the choice of FIFO or DIDO arrangements. Working within a collaborative and experienced project team, you'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact while further developing your project management career in a dynamic mining environment. 
   What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please call Jennah Murray 07 4960 1129. 
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

Solution Architect  
   
 PERSOL is one of Australia's largest and longest serving recruitment providers. Delivering both quality temporary and permanent options, we specialise in the recruitment of Professional, ICT, Government, STEM, Management and Executive talent. 
 Our client is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to join a high-performing team delivering complex and innovative software solutions within a large-scale industrial and technology environment. 
   
 Roster:                  Monday-Friday Perth based 
 Start date:           ASAP 
 Duration:             approx. 12 months - depending on client requirements 
 Pay Rate:              $110.00 p/h + Super depending on experience 
   
  Please note that only people with relevant experience will be considered and contacted.  
   
  The Role:   
 This position plays a critical role in bridging business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring solutions are scalable, efficient and aligned with broader product strategies and architectural standards. 
 Working closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, Systems Engineers, Development Teams and QA, you will be responsible for designing solutions that extend and enhance existing systems while supporting seamless integration across multiple technologies and platforms. 
   
  Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:     
 
 Develop solution designs aligned with established architecture frameworks, product standards and high-level system designs. 
 Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 Break solution designs into clear and actionable work packages for software delivery teams. 
 Define system dependencies and interface requirements to ensure successful integration across multiple components and systems. 
 Ensure all solution designs comply with functional safety and engineering requirements. 
 Analyse existing systems and identify opportunities for enhancement, optimisation and standardisation. 
 Provide technical guidance and design support throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Define API and third-party integration methods in accordance with established standards. 
 Select and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks for efficient implementation. 
 Produce and maintain architecture documentation, including system diagrams, component interactions and data flows. 
 
  Required Experience:   
 
 Extensive experience designing and delivering complex software solutions. 
 Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices. 
 Proven experience with systems integration, APIs and interface design. 
 Experience translating high-level requirements into detailed technical designs. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Experience working within Agile or product-based delivery environments. 
 Exposure to work package creation and project delivery methodologies. 
 
  Highly Regarded:   
 
 Experience within mining, industrial technology, autonomous systems, robotics, defence or heavy industry environments. 
 Exposure to functional safety standards and requirements. 
 Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering and software teams.

CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER / PROJECT BUILDER
EZZI BUILDING SERVICES PTY LTD
PERTH WESTERN AUSTRALIA 6036
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: FULL-TIME PERMANENT
SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is seeking suitably qualified and experienced applicants for the positions of Construction Project Manager and Project Builder in Perth, Western Australia. The successful applicant will be responsible for managing residential and/or commercial construction projects from planning through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard of workmanship.

Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for overseeing construction projects, coordinating labour and subcontractors, liaising with clients, suppliers and consultants, and ensuring compliance with Australian building standards, workplace health and safety
requirements and company procedures.
The role requires strong project management capability, practical building knowledge and the ability to supervise works across multiple stages of construction.

Tasks
Key tasks include:
• Planning, coordinating and managing construction projects from commencement to completion.
• Preparing and reviewing project schedules and project plans, construction programs, budgets and work plans.
• Supervising site activities and coordinating trades, subcontractors and suppliers.
• Monitoring project progress, costs, materials, labour and quality of work.
• Interpreting plans, drawings, specifications and building documentation.
• Liaising with clients, architects, engineers, certifiers, local authorities and other stakeholders.
• Ensuring all work complies with relevant building codes, Australian standards, safety regulations and contractual requirements.
• Managing variations, delays, defects, site issues and project reporting.
• Conducting site inspections and ensuring quality control throughout the construction process.
• Maintaining accurate project records, reports, schedules and compliance documentation.

Skills
Applicants should have:
• Strong knowledge of construction methods, project delivery and site management.
• Excellent organisational, planning and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage budgets, timelines, subcontractors and construction resources.
• Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills.
• Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Proficiency with construction project management systems, scheduling tools and Microsoft Office or similar software.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold relevant qualifications in building, construction management, project management, civil construction, or a related field.
Relevant Australian or overseas qualifications may be considered, including a diploma, advanced diploma, bachelor degree or equivalent trade/background experience in the building and construction industry.

Experience
Applicants must have relevant experience in construction project management, building supervision or project delivery, if a bachelor's degree is present. If no degree, then at least 5 years of experience in the relevant industry.
Previous experience in residential, commercial or mixed-use construction projects will be highly regarded. Experience managing subcontractors, construction schedules, budgets, compliance requirements and client communications is essential.
Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Location: 		6/14 Mason Street Cannington WA 6107
Salary: 			$97,500 Plus 12% Superannuation

Our client, Red Steel Works Pty Ltd. is a prominent Perth based company that specializes in providing reliable and high-quality steel fixing, formwork, precast labor, and scaffolding services for a diverse range of civil, industrial, commercial, and residential projects across Perth and Western Australia.

The client is currently recruiting experienced Formwork Carpenters with a solid background working on residential/ commercial projects to work at the multiple sites.

As a highly motivated and qualified Formwork Carpenter you will require strong technical knowledge of the building and construction industry combined with a high level of attention to detail.  

Minimum Requirements:

AQF Certificate III in relevant trade including 2 years on job training or AQF Certificate IV. At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications. The position requires at least one year of full -time experience and the ability to work independently to specifications and plans.  

What you will be responsible for:

-	Execute quality formwork carpentry workmanship to the highest level, whilst maintaining our company standards and safety 
-	Read plans and specifications to determine the dimensions, materials required and installation processes to be followed
-	Select appropriate materials for formwork construction, considering factors such as load-bearing capacity, durability, and reusability
-	Create formwork that matches the desired shape and dimensions of concrete structures
-	Interpret plans/engineering and project specifications to meet exacting standards 
-	Construct and repair structural woodwork and equipment from blueprints and oral instructions 
-	Install formwork on-site, pouring concrete into the formwork, and then removing the formwork after the concrete has cured
-	Maintain tools and machinery in safe and efficient operating condition
-	Prepare drawings and sketches of construction and repair projects
-	Estimate costs and orders materials needed.
-	Cut materials, and assemble and nail cut and shaped parts
-	Ensure compliance with relevant building codes, safety standards, and regulations
-	Liaise with clients, other trades in a professional manner
-	Adhere to safety regulations and protocols to maintain a safe working environment
Skills, experience and attributes:
-	Able to read and work from plans
-	Proficiency in carpentry techniques such as cutting, shaping, and joining wood or other materials to construct formwork accurately
-	Ability to manage multiple tasks
-	Must have vast experience in civil formwork, carpentry and be skilled in the use of hand and power tools
-	Ability to troubleshoot and solve problems that may arise during formwork construction
-	Demonstrate an understanding of, and commitment to OH&S principles
-	Able to work unsupervised

The Successful Applicant

You would be required to work in a team environment and would be expected to take on a variety of tasks. You would be required to work at times under pressure and timelines and be available to work in different areas if and when the need arises. The applicant must have an OHS white card and previous experience, preferably in the construction industry.

Full-time Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in NSW.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician
•	Salary Range: $90,000 - $105,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.
•	Maintain comprehensive digital and physical records of all inspections, tests, and rectification works using the company’s designated field service management software.
•	Capture and upload clear photographic evidence of pre- and post-rectification works.
•	Ensure the correct use, maintenance, and storage of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), tools, and company vehicles.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and AS 1851 as they relate to passive fire protection.
•	Ability to read, interpret, and work from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and fire matrix schedules.
•	High level of attention to detail and precision in workmanship.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex compliance issues on-site.
•	Proficiency in using mobile technology (tablets/smartphones) and field service management software for reporting and documentation.
•	Excellent time management skills with the capacity to work autonomously and manage a daily schedule of site visits.
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Certificate III level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $90,000-$105,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

This role is based in a busy factory environment and will involve all aspects of factory work required to complete the job and prepare the goods for installation.

Join the School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. You will contribute to research and teaching in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with a focus on learning paradigms, models, and architectures for electronic learning systems. You will also teach across undergraduate and postgraduate Electrical Engineering programs and undertake research in machine learning, artificial intelligence, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, and related emerging technologies.

Position Details

o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation
